privacy.heading: Cookies and privacy
privacy.lead: What WebScreen β stores in cookies, and what information it handles.

cookies.name: ws_oauth_state
cookies.purpose: Protects the Discord sign-in flow against forgery

cookies.name: _ga / _ga_*
cookies.purpose: Aggregates usage statistics via Google Analytics

paragraphs: When you sign in with Discord we store your Discord user ID, display name and avatar URL. We never receive your email address or password.

Converted videos get a public URL containing a hard-to-guess random ID. VRChat video players fetch it without authentication, so anyone who knows the URL can play it. Please do not upload anything you need to keep private.

We use Google Analytics to improve the site. The page URL, referrer, approximate region and browser type are sent to Google. The names and contents of the files you upload are never sent (analytics is not loaded on video preview pages).
To opt out, install the Google Analytics Opt-out Browser Add-on that Google distributes, or block cookies in your browser settings.
You can delete or block cookies in your browser settings. Features that require signing in will not work if you do.

web.title: Show a web page in VRChat: convert a URL to video — WebScreen
web.navLabel: Turn a web page into video
web.heading: Show a web page in VRChat
web.lead: VRChat video players only play video. WebScreen captures a whole web page and encodes it as an MP4, so you can show the page itself by pasting the URL it gives you.
web.description: Paste the URL of the page you want to show and get a video that plays in VRChat. The seek bar scrolls the page for you.

sections.heading: You cannot paste a web page URL into a video player
sections.body: The video players placed in VRChat worlds only play video. Typing a web page URL into one shows nothing. To show what is on the page, you have to turn it into a video first.

sections.heading: The whole page becomes one video
sections.body: WebScreen captures the page from top to bottom and encodes the scroll into an MP4. The seek bar of the video player becomes the scroll of the page, so you can stop wherever you want to talk.

sections.heading: Long pages are not cut off
sections.body: When a page does not fit in a single capture, the rest is fetched automatically and joined into one video. Pages that are still too long cannot be converted, so split them into shorter pages first.

steps: Sign in with Discord. There is no password to create.
Paste the URL of the page into "Convert a web page to video" on the home page.
The conversion returns a video URL. Paste it into a VRChat video player to watch it.

screenShare.title: Screen sharing in VRChat, and what to use instead — WebScreen
screenShare.heading: When you want to share your screen in VRChat
screenShare.lead: Sharing your screen in VRChat usually means showing someone a web page, a slide deck or a photo. WebScreen turns that content into a video URL that plays in any world with a video player.
screenShare.description: Want to share your screen in VRChat? For web pages and slides, converting them to video is the reliable way — no lag, no world requirements.

sections.heading: How people show things in VRChat
sections.body: VRChat has no built-in way to mirror your desktop. To show something you use the video players and slide systems placed in worlds. Both of them play video, so whatever you want to show has to be a video first.

sections.heading: For web pages, slides and images, converting to video is the reliable option
sections.body: A video plays in any world that has a video player. There is no streaming delay and no audio drift, and because the URL keeps working you can show the same thing again the next time you meet.

sections.heading: Real-time screen sharing and screen recording are not supported
sections.body: WebScreen converts web pages, images and PDFs. It cannot mirror what is on your screen right now, and it cannot record you using an application and stream that. Both are still on the way.

steps: Decide what you want to show: a URL for a web page, a PDF for slides, an image file for photos.
Sign in with Discord, then enter the URL or upload the file on the home page.
Paste the video URL into the video player in the world.
screenShare.cta: Convert what you want to show

image.title: Show images and photos in VRChat: convert images to video — WebScreen
image.heading: Show images and photos in VRChat
image.lead: Turn the photos you took on a world tour or with friends into a video so everyone in VRChat can look at them together. Several images become one video, and you only share one URL.
image.description: Turn photos from world hopping or meetups into a video URL you can show in VRChat. Several images become a single video.

sections.heading: Show the photos you just took
sections.body: Screenshots from a world or an event become playable on a video player once they are converted. You do not have to send files to anyone or point them at an external uploader.

sections.heading: Several images become one video
sections.body: Upload a few images at once and they are lined up in order in a single video. There is no need to convert them one by one and swap the URL each time.

sections.heading: Supported image formats
sections.body: png, jpg, jpeg, webp and gif are supported, up to 50 MB per file.

steps: Sign in with Discord. There is no password to create.
Drag and drop your images onto the home page. You can select several at once.
Paste the video URL into a VRChat video player.

pdf.title: Show slides in VRChat: convert a PDF to video — WebScreen
pdf.navLabel: Turn slides and PDFs into video
pdf.heading: Show slides and PDFs in VRChat
pdf.lead: Export PowerPoint or Google Slides as a PDF, convert it, and present straight from a VRChat video player. Up to 200 pages per file.
pdf.description: Export your slides as a PDF and convert it, and you can present straight from a VRChat video player.

sections.heading: Export slides as a PDF first
sections.body: PowerPoint, Keynote and Google Slides can all export a PDF. Upload that PDF and each page becomes one frame of the video, with fonts and layout exactly as you exported them.

sections.heading: Move between pages with the seek bar
sections.body: Drag the seek bar of the video player to reach the page you want. You can go back as well, which helps when you answer questions while you present.

sections.heading: Up to 200 pages
sections.body: A single PDF can hold up to 200 pages, and up to 50 MB. Export long documents chapter by chapter.

steps: Export your slides as a PDF.
Sign in with Discord and drop the PDF onto the home page.
Paste the video URL into the video player or the slide system in the world.
